articles.title: Why the World Athletics Ultimate Championships is ‘unashamedly’ aimed at TV
articles.description: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championships take place this weekend in Budapest, Hungary, and will feature Mondo Duplantis.

articles.title: Jakob Ingebrigtsen has rebuilt himself and reignited the men’s 5,000m
articles.description: Just a month back from a persistent Achilles injury, Jakob Ingebrigtsen is looking as strong as ever after another international triumph.
